notes.title: Flood Fill - Minor Update - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[u][h2]Changes[/h2][/u]
[list]
[*] Added a 'Resume' button in the pause menu.
[*] Added tutorial text explaining that the 'R' key is used to restart a level.
[/list]

[u][h2]Fixes[/h2][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the player sometimes unintentionally moving 2 units when a movement key is quickly pressed and released.
[/list]
